open_points.subject: flows highest_effect_class ordering
open_points.text: `flows` owns "... the highest effect class ..."; `flows` knows `models`, `canonical_values`, `clock`, `store`, `functions`, `bindings`
open_points.question: How does `flows` get the authoritative effect-class order when that order is owned by `data_provider` but `flows` cannot know `data_provider`?
open_points.default_guess: Duplicate the order in `flows` to unblock implementation, even though it risks drift.

open_points.subject: attempt_number assignment across runs and effects
open_points.text: `effects` owns "... EffectAttempts and attempt numbers ..."; `runs` owns "... the trace and its order ..."
open_points.question: Which module assigns the next `attempt_number` for NodeExecution records that are written by run progression (for example skip/upstream-failed/refused paths) but still participate in A11's single ordinal sequence per element?
options: `runs` is the single allocator of NodeExecution attempt numbers and `effects` consumes it
`effects` is the single allocator and `runs` must call into it for every NodeExecution on operation elements
Split by case (effects for sends, runs for non-sends)
open_points.default_guess: Make `runs` allocate NodeExecution attempt numbers and pass them into `effects` for send attempts.

open_points.subject: startup spool cleanup responsibility
open_points.text: `store` owns "... start-time removal of temporary files and of spools no longer kept"; `store` must not own "when a run's spool is emptied or released (that is `runs`)"
open_points.question: At startup, who decides whether a specific run spool is "no longer kept" under A14/A15 lifecycle rules: `store` or `runs`?
options: `runs` decides and instructs `store` what to delete
`store` deletes only temp files; all spool-eligibility decisions move to `runs`
open_points.default_guess: Have `runs` decide keep/remove eligibility and call `store` for deletions.

open_points.subject: A21 security-review enforcement
open_points.text: "Derived from the accepted State 2 decisions A01–A21"
open_points.question: Which module owns enforcing or materializing A21 (`state2_security_gate_pass`, complete review record, decision-reference checks), since no module section names it?
options: Treat A21 as build/design tooling outside runtime modules
Add a runtime module responsibility (for example `surface` startup gate)
Explicitly mark A21 as non-code governance with no module owner
open_points.default_guess: Treat A21 as external design/build tooling and leave runtime modules without enforcement.
